questions.question: What does David wish for to escape his distress?
options: Speed like a deer, to escape his pursuers
Walls like a city, to shut out the enemy
Wings like a dove, to fly away and be at rest
Strength like a lion, to face down his foes
questions.answer: Wings like a dove, to fly away and be at rest

questions.question: What hurt David most about his betrayer?
options: It was a foreigner from a distant nation
It was a powerful king of the land
It was his familiar friend and companion
It was a stranger he had never known
questions.answer: It was his familiar friend and companion
